purpose: Capture useful technical corrections during a Source Completion Queue as low-noise ML-ready experience without creating extra coordination queues or commits per event.

capture.granularity: one event per materially distinct root cause and correction
do_not_capture: duplicate symptoms of the same unresolved cause

linkage.operational_record: final Result references journal ID and counts
linkage.ml_experience: Acquisition Experience Record references journal and summarizes patterns

quality_rules: do not infer a root cause before evidence supports it; use unknown when necessary
record quality and effort as null when not observed
merge duplicate symptoms into one event
separate pre-provider correction from provider/data-quality failure
a corrected event must cite the validation that proved resolution

approval.explicit_user_instruction: ให้ codex บันทึก technical correction เก็บไว้เป็นข้อมูลสำหรับการพัฒนา ML ระหว่างรันได้หรือไม่ครับ
